The recorded trace **ends at the forced-termination message** — there is no final assistant summary captured in the row. Every browser action failed with resource/timeout/abort errors; the only "successful" calls (`browser_console`) returned empty buffers. The agent never identified any book, price, or review rating, and the core task — finding the best-priced book with the best reviews — was never accomplished.
